# Intuit

> Intuit is a financial software platform powering small businesses, consumers, and accountants with AI-driven tools for tax preparation, accounting, payroll, and financial management.

Intuit operates a suite of flagship products including TurboTax for tax filing, QuickBooks for accounting and business management, Credit Karma for personal finance, and Mailchimp for marketing automation. The company serves consumers, small businesses, accountants, and enterprises globally with integrated financial solutions.

- [Intuit Official Site](https://www.intuit.com): Intuit platform homepage featuring TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, Mailchimp

- [QuickBooks Official Site](https://quickbooks.intuit.com): QuickBooks accounting software for small business management with AI-powered tools
- [Products Overview](https://www.intuit.com/products): Intuit product overview page featuring TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma

## Professional & Enterprise Solutions

- [Accountants Professional Solutions](https://www.intuit.com/accountants): Intuit professional accounting solutions including ProConnect and Lacerte Tax
- [Enterprise Resource Planning Suite](https://www.intuit.com/enterprise): Intuit Enterprise Suite ERP software for multi-entity business management
- [Tax Pro Center](https://accountants.intuit.com/taxprocenter): Tax Pro Center with articles, tools, and insights for tax professionals
